factoryName.metadata: Nombre de instancia de Data Factory

scriptLines:
query: 'SELECT
    am."1st Flr SF" + am."2nd Flr SF" + am."Low Qual Fin SF"  AS "Gr Liv Area",
    COALESCE(fd.fullbath, 0)                               AS "Full Bath",
    COALESCE(fd.halfbath, 0)                               AS "Half Bath",
    COALESCE(fd.bedroom, 0)                                 AS "Bedroom AbvGr",
    CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM sp."Sale Date") AS integer)     AS "Mo Sold",
    CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR  FROM sp."Sale Date") AS integer)     AS "Yr Sold",
    am.pid                                                 AS "PID",
    am."MS SubClass"                                       AS "MS SubClass",
    mz.code                                                AS "MS Zoning",
    am."Roof Style"                                        AS "Roof Style",
    am."Roof Matl"                                         AS "Roof Matl",
    am."Exterior 1st"                                      AS "Exterior 1st",
    am."Exterior 2nd"                                      AS "Exterior 2nd",
    COALESCE(am."Mas Vnr Type", 'NA')                      AS "Mas Vnr Type",
    COALESCE(am."Mas Vnr Area", 0)                         AS "Mas Vnr Area",
    eq.code                                                AS "Exter Qual",
    ec.code                                                AS "Exter Cond",
    am.foundation                                          AS "Foundation",
    am.heating                                             AS "Heating",
    hq.code                                                AS "Heating QC",
    CASE WHEN am."Central Air" THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END       AS "Central Air",
    COALESCE(am.electrical, 'NA')                          AS "Electrical",
    am."1st Flr SF"                                        AS "1st Flr SF",
    am."2nd Flr SF"                                        AS "2nd Flr SF",
    am."Low Qual Fin SF"                                   AS "Low Qual Fin SF",
    am."Kitchen AbvGr"                                     AS "Kitchen AbvGr",
    kq.code                                                AS "Kitchen Qual",
    am."TotRms AbvGrd"                                     AS "TotRms AbvGrd",
    am.functional                                          AS "Functional",
    am.fireplaces                                          AS "Fireplaces",
    am."Fireplace Qu"                                      AS "Fireplace Qu",
    am."Paved Drive"                                       AS "Paved Drive",
    am."Wood Deck SF"                                      AS "Wood Deck SF",
    am."Open Porch SF"                                     AS "Open Porch SF",
    am."Enclosed Porch"                                    AS "Enclosed Porch",
    am."3Ssn Porch"                                        AS "3Ssn Porch",
    am."Screen Porch"                                      AS "Screen Porch",
    am.fence                                               AS "Fence",
    sp."Sale Type"                                         AS "Sale Type",
    sp."Sale Condition"                                    AS "Sale Condition",
    sp.saleprice                                           AS "SalePrice"
FROM public.amesdbtemp am
LEFT JOIN public.mszoning     mz ON mz.id = am."MS Zoning"
LEFT JOIN public.typequality  eq ON eq.id = am."Exter Qual"
LEFT JOIN public.typequality  ec ON ec.id = am."Exter Cond"
LEFT JOIN public.typequality  hq ON hq.id = am."Heating QC"
LEFT JOIN public.typequality  kq ON kq.id = am."Kitchen Qual"
LEFT JOIN public.saleproperty sp ON sp.pid = am.pid
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT pid,
           CAST(SUM(bedrooms)    AS integer) AS bedroom,
           CAST(SUM("Full Bath") AS integer) AS fullbath,
           CAST(SUM("Half Bath") AS integer) AS halfbath
    FROM public.floordetail
    GROUP BY pid
) fd ON fd.pid = am.pid',
joinmisc derive({Year Remod/Add} = iifNull({Year Remod/Add}, {Year Built}),
{Garage Yr Blt} = iifNull({Garage Yr Blt}, toShort('0')),
{Bsmt Unf SF} = iifNull({Bsmt Unf SF}, toShort('0')),
{Total Bsmt SF} = iifNull({Total Bsmt SF}, toShort('0')),
{Bsmt Full Bath} = iifNull({Bsmt Full Bath}, toShort('0')),
{Bsmt Half Bath} = iifNull({Bsmt Half Bath}, toShort('0')),

{Lot Shape} = case(     {Lot Shape} == 'Regular', 'Reg',     {Lot Shape} == 'Slightly irregular', 'IR1',     {Lot Shape} == 'Moderately Irregular', 'IR2',     {Lot Shape} == 'Irregular', 'IR3',     {Lot Shape} ),

Neighborhood = case(     Neighborhood == 'Bloomington Heights', 'Blmngtn',     Neighborhood == 'Bluestem', 'Blueste',     Neighborhood == 'Briardale', 'BrDale',     Neighborhood == 'Brookside', 'BrkSide',     Neighborhood == 'Clear Creek', 'ClearCr',     Neighborhood == 'College Creek', 'CollgCr',     Neighborhood == 'Crawford', 'Crawfor',     Neighborhood == 'Iowa DOT and Rail Road', 'IDOTRR',     Neighborhood == 'Meadow Village', 'MeadowV',     Neighborhood == 'Mitchell', 'Mitchel',     Neighborhood == 'North Ames', 'Names',     Neighborhood == 'Northridge', 'NoRidge',     Neighborhood == 'Northpark Villa', 'NPkVill',     Neighborhood == 'Northridge Heights', 'NridgHt',     Neighborhood == 'Northwest Ames', 'NWAmes',     Neighborhood == 'Old Town', 'OldTown',     Neighborhood == 'South & West of Iowa State University', 'SWISU',     Neighborhood == 'Sawyer West', 'SawyerW',     Neighborhood == 'Somerset', 'Somerst',     Neighborhood == 'Stone Brook', 'StoneBr',     Neighborhood == 'Timberland', 'Timber',     Neighborhood ),

{Condition 1} = case(     {Condition 1} == 'Normal', 'Norm',     {Condition 1} == 'Adjacent to feeder street', 'Feedr',     {Condition 1} == 'Adjacent to arterial street', 'Artery',     {Condition 1} == 'Adjacent to East-West Railroad', 'RRAe',     {Condition 1} == 'Adjacent to North-South Railroad', 'RRAn',     startsWith({Condition 1}, 'Within 200') && endsWith({Condition 1}, 'North-South Railroad'), 'RRNn',     startsWith({Condition 1}, 'Within 200') && endsWith({Condition 1}, 'East-West Railroad'), 'RRNe',     startsWith({Condition 1}, 'Near positive'), 'PosN',     startsWith({Condition 1}, 'Adjacent to pos'), 'PosA',     {Condition 1} ),

{Condition 2} = case(     {Condition 2} == 'Normal', 'Norm',     {Condition 2} == 'Adjacent to feeder street', 'Feedr',     {Condition 2} == 'Adjacent to arterial street', 'Artery',     {Condition 2} == 'Adjacent to East-West Railroad', 'RRAe',     {Condition 2} == 'Adjacent to North-South Railroad', 'RRAn',     startsWith({Condition 2}, 'Within 200') && endsWith({Condition 2}, 'North-South Railroad'), 'RRNn',     startsWith({Condition 2}, 'Within 200') && endsWith({Condition 2}, 'East-West Railroad'), 'RRNe',     startsWith({Condition 2}, 'Near positive'), 'PosN',     startsWith({Condition 2}, 'Adjacent to pos'), 'PosA',     {Condition 2} ),
